registered: see the git commit that added this file (2026-10-04/05), made before corpus v2 existed and before any v2 training run
class: controlled experiment; development on corpus-v2 VAL only; TEST untouched until one pre-selected candidate is scored once
motivation: the generalization series supported a motion-matched temporal window (t-4, t, t+4: +0.045 CST drone AP50 on held-out folds) that needs 4 future frames (+160 ms at 25 fps), a real-time liability

the corpus used so far lacks 36 of 120 CST training sequences (every urban-areas and water sequence) and the official 40-sequence CST val split (truncated archive, docs/AGENT_CONTEXT.md); the dominant test failure was exactly those scene types
corpus: b_pipeline/data_unified_v2 (complete CST release; experiments/cst_completion); identity recorded by the runner at campaign start

configurations.stock: YOLO11n stride layout, input [t, t, t]
configurations.sym_g4: same network, input [t-4, t, t+4] (the generalization series' supported window)
configurations.causal_g4: same network, input [t-4, t, t-8]: past frames only, zero look-ahead

held_fixed: c_model/train.py STAGES['baseline'] recipe (20 epochs x 25,000 weighted samples, batch 32 x accumulate 2, AdamW 1e-3 cosine), letterbox 640, augmentation, sampler, function-preserving initialisation (every configuration starts as COCO YOLO11n on frame t), checkpoint = last.pt
evaluation: corpus-v2 VAL, every dataset capped at 5,000 images evenly over its sequences (same frames for every configuration), conf 0.001 / NMS IoU 0.7 / max_det 30 / bf16
primary_metric: cst (CST drone AP50 on the official CST val split)
secondary: CST drone AP50 per scene category

rules.superiority: (1) seed-mean delta > margin; (2) delta > 0 for every seed; (3) paired, dataset-stratified, sequence-level bootstrap 95 % CI of the seed-mean delta excludes 0 (B = 1000); (4) seed-mean Anti-UAV delta > -0.02
rules.non_inferiority: seed-mean delta >= -margin; called conclusive only if the CI lower bound >= -margin

comparisons.question: symmetric window vs single frame (replication on complete data)
causal vs symmetric window (cost of removing the look-ahead)
data effect: complete vs truncated CST training data (same window, seed 0; n = 1 seed, CI = sampling noise only)

run_order: evaluate gen_temporal_fp_g4_full_e20 (v1-trained, seed 0) on v2 VAL (no training)
stage 1: v2_stock_s0, v2_sym_g4_s0, v2_causal_g4_s0 (train, then evaluate each)

futility after stage 1: a candidate whose seed-0 CST delta vs stock is <= 0 cannot satisfy superiority rule (2) and is not run at seed 1; stock_s1 runs if any candidate survives; if none survives stage 2 is skipped
stage 2: seed 1 of stock and of the surviving candidates

selection_rule.note: the selected configuration's seed-0 run is the final candidate; it is scored on corpus-v2 TEST once, after the tracker/state estimator has been designed on VAL

test_usage: none in this series until the final candidate's single pre-registered pass (reports/v2_test_ledger.jsonl refuses a second one)
hardware: local OMEN RTX 5050 Laptop (remote HPC access unavailable as of 2026-10-04)
